prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City—what’s best depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline, and whether you need broad integrated services (branding + advertising + media) or a narrow specialty (SEO, paid media, social, web design, B2B demand gen).

How to find the best fit
- Define your goal(s): brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, product launch, etc.  
- Decide scope: full-service integrated agency or a specialist (SEO, PPC, creative, UX).  
- Set budget and timeline (agencies range from freelancers to global firms).  
- Evaluate candidates by: case studies and measurable results, references, client retention, team experience, reporting/analytics approach, and cultural fit.

Agencies in Kansas City worth considering
- Large/full-service (national reach + big creative/digital capabilities): Barkley; VML (VMLY&R started in KC).  
- Boutique/specialists: There are many local firms that focus on digital strategy, performance marketing, web design, or PR—these tend to be more affordable and flexible for smaller projects.

How I can help right now
- If you tell me: your industry, what you want to accomplish, your monthly/annual budget, and whether you need local-only partners, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Kansas City agencies (and why each might fit), plus sample questions to ask in interviews.  
- Or I can show you how to research and compare agencies yourself (best review sites, what to request in an RFP, sample evaluation template).

Which would you prefer?
